course.title: Chemical Engineering MEng | Imperial College London
quotes: Qualification MEng Duration 4 years Start date October 2027 UCAS course code H801
Delivered by Department of Chemical Engineering
Minimum entry standard A*A*A To include: A* in Chemistry A* in Mathematics A in Biology, Business Studies, Economics, Further Mathematics or Physics
Minimum entry standard 40 points To include: 7 in Mathematics at higher level 7 in Chemistry at higher level 6 in Biology, Business Management, Economics or Physics at higher level

EITHER 5, 5, 5, 5, 5 to include Chemistry and Calculus BC and at least one of Physics, Biology or Economics OR 5, 5, 5 to include Chemistry and Calculus BC and one of Physics, Biology or Economics Award of acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g., US High School Diploma) Either 1480 in SAT or 33 in ACT.
Our minimum entry standard is 92% overall, to include: 95% in Mathematics 95% / 90% including Chemistry
Our minimum entry standard is 1.4 overall, to include the following abiturprufung exams: 14 in Mathematics 14 in Chemistry
you will need to sit three ESAT modules: Mathematics 1 Mathematics 2 Chemistry
must achieve the standard university requirement
Application deadlines - Wednesday 13 January 2027 at 18.00 (UK time)
